name: Adaro Mystic
body:
Adaro Mystic
CR 7

This hybrid of human and shark holds its spear menacingly, thick, glistening saliva dripping from its razor-sharp teeth.

XP 3,200
NE Medium monstrous humanoid (aquatic)
Init +7; Senses Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 14, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +7 natural)
hp 76 (9d10+27)
Fort +5 Ref +8 Will +7

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., swim 50 ft.
Melee spear +13/+8 (1d8+6/x3), bite +8 (1d6+4)
Ranged spear +12 (1d8+4/x3)
Special Attacks rain frenzy
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +11)

3/day—command (DC 15), cure moderate wounds, protection from energy
1/day—control water, hold person

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 17, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 18
Base Atk +9; CMB +13; CMD 26
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (spear)
Skills Intimidate +16, Perception +13, Stealth +15, Swim +24
Languages Aquan, Common; speak with sharks
SQ amphibious, poison use

ECOLOGY

Environment warm oceans
Organization solitary, hunting party (2-6), or tribe (7-12)
Treasure standard (3 spears, other treasure)

This hybrid of human and shark holds its spear menacingly, thick, glistening saliva dripping from its razor-sharp teeth.
